import time

try:
    import gc
except ImportError:
    gc = None

GREEN = 0x36D399
AMBER = 0xFFC857
RED = 0xFF7A72
MUTED = 0x7F93A8
CYAN = 0x45C8FF
SOURCE_NAMES = ("SIMULATION", "TCP", "SERIAL", "BLE")
SCENARIO_NAMES = ("NORMAL", "TEMP_HIGH", "FAN_STALL", "LINK_LOST", "RECOVERY")
SCENARIO_DESCRIPTIONS = (
    "NORMAL: stable ambient values and gradual fan tracking.",
    "TEMP_HIGH: temperature rises by about 0.8 C/s until it crosses the configured threshold.",
    "FAN_STALL: confirmed RPM is capped at 300 while the requested setpoint remains unchanged.",
    "LINK_LOST: reception stops for 12 seconds; values become STALE, then reception resumes.",
    "RECOVERY: temperature and fan return progressively to normal operating values.",
)
REFRESH_MS = (250, 500, 1000, 2000)


def valid_number(value, low, high):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        return None
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if value != value or value == float("inf") or value == float("-inf"):
        return None
    if value < low or value > high:
        return None
    return value


def clock_text(seconds):
    seconds = max(0, int(seconds))
    return "%02d:%02d:%02d" % (seconds // 3600, (seconds // 60) % 60, seconds % 60)


class RingBuffer:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.values = [0] * capacity
        self.start = 0
        self.count = 0

    def append(self, value):
        if self.count < self.capacity:
            self.values[(self.start + self.count) % self.capacity] = value
            self.count += 1
        else:
            self.values[self.start] = value
            self.start = (self.start + 1) % self.capacity

    def latest(self, wanted):
        size = min(wanted, self.count)
        result = [0] * size
        first = (self.start + self.count - size) % self.capacity
        for i in range(size):
            result[i] = self.values[(first + i) % self.capacity]
        return result

    def stats(self, wanted, scale=1):
        size = min(wanted, self.count)
        if size == 0:
            return None
        first = (self.start + self.count - size) % self.capacity
        total = 0
        low = None
        high = None
        for i in range(size):
            value = self.values[(first + i) % self.capacity]
            total += value
            if low is None or value < low:
                low = value
            if high is None or value > high:
                high = value
        return low / scale, high / scale, total / size / scale


class EIMApplication:
    def __init__(self):
        self.started = False
        self.page = 0
        self.temp_threshold = 40.0
        self.power_threshold = 10.5
        self.stall_delay = 5
        self.refresh_ms = 1000
        self.source = 0
        self.simulator_enabled = True
        self.scenario = 0
        self.scenario_seconds = 0
        self.seed = 1
        self.requested = 50
        self.running = True
        self.auto = True
        self.temp = 24.6
        self.humidity = 48.0
        self.rpm = 1450.0
        self.voltage = 12.1
        self.power = 7.4
        self.sequence = 0
        self.received = 0
        self.discarded = 0
        self.last_rx = 0
        self.last_event = "Simulator started"
        self.temp_history = RingBuffer(900)
        self.fan_history = RingBuffer(900)
        self.stall_seconds = 0
        self.trend_window = 60
        self.trend_paused = False
        self.trend_needs_reload = True
        self.overview_chart_sequence = -1
        self.trend_chart_sequence = -1
        self.alarms = [
            {"code": "TEMP_HIGH", "level": "ALARM", "state": "CLEARED", "time": "--:--:--"},
            {"code": "FAN_STALL", "level": "ALARM", "state": "CLEARED", "time": "--:--:--"},
            {"code": "SENSOR_LOST", "level": "ALARM", "state": "CLEARED", "time": "--:--:--"},
            {"code": "LINK_LOST", "level": "WARNING", "state": "CLEARED", "time": "--:--:--"},
            {"code": "POWER_LOW", "level": "ALARM", "state": "CLEARED", "time": "--:--:--"},
        ]

    def start(self):
        if self.started:
            return
        self.started = True
        self.compact = lv.screen_active().get_width() <= 480
        now = time.ticks_ms()
        self.start_ms = now
        self.last_tick = now
        self.sample_elapsed = 0
        self.ui_elapsed = 0
        self.last_rx = now
        self.ov_temp_series = ui.ov_temp_chart.get_series_next(None)
        self.tr_temp_series = ui.tr_temp_chart.get_series_next(None)
        self.tr_fan_series = ui.tr_fan_chart.get_series_next(None)
        ui.ov_temp_chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, 500)
        ui.tr_temp_chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, 500)
        self.sample()
        self.refresh_ui()

    def uptime(self):
        if not self.started:
            return 0
        return time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), self.start_ms) // 1000

    def random_unit(self):
        self.seed = (self.seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF
        return (self.seed % 2001 - 1000) / 1000.0

    def link_up(self):
        if self.source != 0 or not self.simulator_enabled:
            return False
        return not (self.scenario == 3 and self.scenario_seconds < 12)

    def set_requested(self, value):
        self.requested = max(0, min(100, int(value)))
        self.auto = False
        self.last_event = "Manual fan setpoint: %d %%" % self.requested

    def toggle_mode(self):
        self.auto = not self.auto
        if self.auto:
            self.requested = 50
            ui.ov_speed_slider.set_value(50, False)
        self.last_event = "Fan mode: " + ("AUTO" if self.auto else "MANUAL")

    def toggle_running(self):
        self.running = not self.running
        self.last_event = "Fan " + ("START requested" if self.running else "STOP requested")

    def set_scenario(self, index):
        self.scenario = max(0, min(4, int(index)))
        self.scenario_seconds = 0
        self.stall_seconds = 0
        self.seed = 100 + self.scenario
        if self.scenario != 4:
            self.temp = 24.6
            self.humidity = 48.0
            self.rpm = 1450.0
            self.voltage = 12.1
        self.running = True
        if self.scenario in (0, 1, 3):
            self.requested = 50
        self.source = 0
        self.simulator_enabled = True
        self.last_event = "Demo scenario: " + SCENARIO_NAMES[self.scenario]
        self.update_alarms()
        self.refresh_ui()

    def simulate_one_second(self):
        self.scenario_seconds += 1
        noise = self.random_unit()
        if self.scenario == 1:
            self.temp += 0.8 + noise * 0.04
        elif self.scenario == 4:
            self.temp += max(-0.7, min(0.2, (24.6 - self.temp) * 0.12)) + noise * 0.03
        else:
            self.temp += max(-0.12, min(0.12, (24.6 - self.temp) * 0.08)) + noise * 0.025
        self.humidity = max(20.0, min(90.0, self.humidity + noise * 0.08 + (48.0 - self.humidity) * 0.02))
        target = self.requested * 30 if self.running else 0
        if self.auto and self.running:
            target = max(target, 1500)
        if self.scenario == 2:
            target = min(target, 300)
        delta = target - self.rpm
        delta = max(-180.0, min(180.0, delta))
        self.rpm = max(0.0, self.rpm + delta)
        self.voltage = 12.1 + noise * 0.025
        self.power = self.voltage * (0.25 + self.rpm / 3000.0 * 0.75)

    def sample(self):
        self.simulate_one_second()
        fresh = self.link_up()
        if fresh:
            self.sequence += 1
            self.received += 1
            self.last_rx = time.ticks_ms()
            new_temp = valid_number(self.temp, -40, 125)
            new_humidity = valid_number(self.humidity, 0, 100)
            new_rpm = valid_number(self.rpm, 0, 10000)
            new_voltage = valid_number(self.voltage, 0, 60)
            if new_temp is None or new_humidity is None or new_rpm is None or new_voltage is None:
                self.discarded += 1
            else:
                self.temp_history.append(int(new_temp * 10))
                self.fan_history.append(int(new_rpm))
                self.trend_needs_reload = self.trend_needs_reload or self.trend_paused
        if fresh and self.running and self.requested >= 10 and self.rpm < self.requested * 15:
            self.stall_seconds += 1
        elif fresh:
            self.stall_seconds = 0
        self.update_alarms()

    def update_alarms(self):
        fresh = self.link_up()
        temp = valid_number(self.temp, -40, 125)
        voltage = valid_number(self.voltage, 0, 60)
        rpm = valid_number(self.rpm, 0, 10000)
        sensor_lost = fresh and (temp is None or valid_number(self.humidity, 0, 100) is None or rpm is None or voltage is None)
        conditions = (
            fresh and temp is not None and temp > self.temp_threshold,
            fresh and self.stall_seconds >= self.stall_delay,
            sensor_lost,
            not fresh,
            fresh and voltage is not None and voltage < self.power_threshold,
        )
        stamp = clock_text(self.uptime())
        for i in range(5):
            alarm = self.alarms[i]
            if conditions[i]:
                if alarm["state"] == "CLEARED":
                    alarm["state"] = "ACTIVE"
                    alarm["time"] = stamp
                    self.last_event = alarm["code"] + " became ACTIVE"
            elif alarm["state"] != "CLEARED":
                alarm["state"] = "CLEARED"
                self.last_event = alarm["code"] + " cleared"

    def acknowledge(self, index):
        if 0 <= index < 5 and self.alarms[index]["state"] == "ACTIVE":
            self.alarms[index]["state"] = "ACKNOWLEDGED"
            self.last_event = self.alarms[index]["code"] + " acknowledged; condition still monitored"

    def acknowledge_all(self):
        for i in range(5):
            self.acknowledge(i)

    def data_age(self):
        if not self.started:
            return 0
        return max(0, time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), self.last_rx) // 1000)

    def stale(self):
        return self.data_age() > 3 or not self.link_up()

    def set_trend_window(self, seconds):
        self.trend_window = seconds
        self.trend_needs_reload = True
        self.refresh_ui()

    def toggle_pause(self):
        self.trend_paused = not self.trend_paused
        if not self.trend_paused:
            self.trend_needs_reload = True
        self.last_event = "Trend scrolling " + ("paused; acquisition continues" if self.trend_paused else "resumed")
        self.refresh_ui()

    def apply_settings(self):
        self.source = ui.se_source.get_selected()
        self.simulator_enabled = ui.se_simulator.has_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
        self.refresh_ms = REFRESH_MS[ui.se_refresh.get_selected()]
        self.temp_threshold = ui.se_temp_threshold.get_value() / 10.0
        self.power_threshold = ui.se_power_threshold.get_value() / 10.0
        self.stall_delay = ui.se_stall_delay.get_value()
        self.last_event = "Runtime settings applied; no persistent write"
        set_label(ui.se_status, "Applied. Source: %s. Settings are runtime only." % SOURCE_NAMES[self.source], GREEN)
        self.update_alarms()
        self.refresh_ui()

    def restore_defaults(self):
        self.temp_threshold = 40.0
        self.power_threshold = 10.5
        self.stall_delay = 5
        self.refresh_ms = 1000
        self.source = 0
        self.simulator_enabled = True
        ui.se_source.set_selected(0)
        ui.se_refresh.set_selected(2)
        ui.se_simulator.add_state(lv.STATE.CHECKED)
        ui.se_temp_threshold.set_value(400)
        ui.se_power_threshold.set_value(105)
        ui.se_stall_delay.set_value(5)
        ui.se_host.set_text("192.168.1.50")
        ui.se_port.set_text("5020")
        ui.se_serial.set_text("/dev/ttyUSB0")
        self.set_scenario(0)
        self.last_event = "Default runtime settings restored"
        set_label(ui.se_status, "Defaults restored. Simulator running; no persistent write.", GREEN)

    def tick(self):
        if not self.started:
            self.start()
            return
        now = time.ticks_ms()
        elapsed = time.ticks_diff(now, self.last_tick)
        self.last_tick = now
        if elapsed < 0:
            return
        self.sample_elapsed += elapsed
        self.ui_elapsed += elapsed
        if self.sample_elapsed >= 1000:
            self.sample_elapsed -= 1000
            self.sample()
        if self.ui_elapsed >= self.refresh_ms:
            self.ui_elapsed = 0
            started = time.ticks_ms()
            self.refresh_ui()
            if self.page == 3:
                set_label(ui.di_perf_value, "%d ms" % time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), started), 0xE7F0F8)

    def page_loaded(self, index):
        self.page = index
        if index == 1:
            self.trend_needs_reload = True
        self.refresh_ui()

    def refresh_ui(self):
        if not self.started:
            return
        prefix = ("ov", "tr", "al", "di", "se")[self.page]
        state, state_color = self.system_state()
        set_label(getattr(ui, prefix + "_system_state"), state, state_color)
        age_text = ("DATA %d s%s" if self.compact else "DATA AGE\n%d s%s") % (self.data_age(), " STALE" if self.stale() else "")
        set_label(getattr(ui, prefix + "_data_age"), age_text, RED if self.stale() else 0x9FB2C5)
        link = SOURCE_NAMES[self.source] if self.link_up() else "OFFLINE"
        set_label(getattr(ui, prefix + "_link"), link, GREEN if self.link_up() else RED)
        set_led(getattr(ui, prefix + "_link_led"), GREEN if self.link_up() else RED)
        if self.page == 0:
            self.refresh_overview()
        elif self.page == 1:
            self.refresh_trends()
        elif self.page == 2:
            self.refresh_alarms()
        elif self.page == 3:
            self.refresh_diagnostics()

    def system_state(self):
        active = 0
        warning = self.stale()
        for alarm in self.alarms:
            if alarm["state"] in ("ACTIVE", "ACKNOWLEDGED"):
                if alarm["level"] == "ALARM":
                    active += 1
                else:
                    warning = True
        if active:
            return "SYSTEM ALARM", RED
        if warning:
            return "SYSTEM WARNING", AMBER
        return "SYSTEM NORMAL", GREEN

    def refresh_overview(self):
        stale = self.stale()
        temp = valid_number(self.temp, -40, 125)
        humidity = valid_number(self.humidity, 0, 100)
        rpm = valid_number(self.rpm, 0, 10000)
        voltage = valid_number(self.voltage, 0, 60)
        set_label(ui.ov_temp_value, "N/A" if temp is None else "%.1f" % temp, RED if temp is None else 0xF3F7FA)
        set_label(ui.ov_hum_value, "N/A" if humidity is None else "%d" % int(humidity), 0xF3F7FA)
        set_label(ui.ov_fan_value, "N/A" if rpm is None else "%d" % int(rpm), 0xF3F7FA)
        set_label(ui.ov_power_value, "N/A" if self.power is None else "%.1f" % self.power, 0xF3F7FA)
        set_label(ui.ov_temp_state, "STALE" if stale else ("ALARM" if temp is not None and temp > self.temp_threshold else "NORMAL"), RED if stale or (temp is not None and temp > self.temp_threshold) else GREEN)
        set_label(ui.ov_hum_state, "STALE" if stale else "NORMAL", RED if stale else GREEN)
        target_rpm = self.requested * 30 if self.running else 0
        fan_target_text = (("S " if stale else "T ") + str(target_rpm)) if self.compact else ("STALE  •  " if stale else "TARGET ") + "%d RPM" % target_rpm
        set_label(ui.ov_fan_target, fan_target_text, RED if stale else GREEN)
        voltage_text = "STALE" if stale else ("N/A" if voltage is None else "%.1f V" % voltage)
        set_label(ui.ov_power_supply, voltage_text if self.compact else (("STALE  •  " if stale else "SUPPLY ") + voltage_text), RED if stale else GREEN)
        for led in (ui.ov_temp_led, ui.ov_hum_led, ui.ov_fan_led, ui.ov_power_led):
            set_led(led, RED if stale else GREEN)
        set_label(ui.ov_requested, "%d %%" % self.requested, CYAN)
        set_label(ui.ov_actual, "N/A" if rpm is None else "%d RPM" % int(rpm), 0xF3F7FA)
        target = self.requested * 30 if self.running else 0
        tracking = abs((rpm or 0) - target) < 100
        confirmation = ("TRACKING" if tracking else "NOT AT SETPOINT") if self.compact else ("CONFIRMED: TRACKING" if tracking else "CONFIRMED: NOT AT SETPOINT")
        set_label(ui.ov_confirmation, confirmation, GREEN if tracking else AMBER)
        mode_text = ("AUTO" if self.auto else "MANUAL") if self.compact else "MODE: " + ("AUTO" if self.auto else "MANUAL")
        set_button(ui.ov_mode, mode_text)
        set_button(ui.ov_start_stop, "STOP" if self.running else "START")
        set_label(ui.ov_threshold_label, "ALARM %.1f °C" % self.temp_threshold, RED)
        chart_y = ui.ov_temp_chart.get_y()
        chart_h = ui.ov_temp_chart.get_height()
        ui.ov_threshold_line.set_y(chart_y + chart_h - int(self.temp_threshold * chart_h / 50))
        set_label(ui.ov_last_event, "Last event: " + self.last_event, 0x8EA4B8)
        active = sum(1 for alarm in self.alarms if alarm["state"] == "ACTIVE")
        acknowledged = sum(1 for alarm in self.alarms if alarm["state"] == "ACKNOWLEDGED")
        alarm_text = ("NONE" if active + acknowledged == 0 else "%d/%d" % (active, acknowledged)) if self.compact else ("NO ACTIVE ALARMS" if active + acknowledged == 0 else "%d ACTIVE  /  %d ACK" % (active, acknowledged))
        set_label(ui.ov_alarm_summary, alarm_text, RED if active + acknowledged else 0x9FB2C5)
        set_led(ui.ov_alarm_led, RED if active + acknowledged else GREEN)
        if temp is not None and not stale and self.overview_chart_sequence != self.sequence:
            ui.ov_temp_chart.set_next_value(self.ov_temp_series, int(temp * 10))
            self.overview_chart_sequence = self.sequence

    def refresh_trends(self):
        set_label(ui.tr_temp_current, "%.1f °C" % self.temp, RED if self.stale() else CYAN)
        set_label(ui.tr_fan_current, "%d RPM" % int(self.rpm), RED if self.stale() else GREEN)
        pause_text = ("RESUME" if self.trend_paused else "PAUSE") if self.compact else ("RESUME SCROLL" if self.trend_paused else "PAUSE SCROLL")
        set_button(ui.tr_pause, pause_text)
        live_text = ("%s %d/%d" if self.compact else "%s  •  %d / %d samples") % ("PAUSED" if self.trend_paused else "LIVE", min(self.trend_window, self.temp_history.count), self.trend_window)
        set_label(ui.tr_live_state, live_text, AMBER if self.trend_paused else GREEN)
        if self.trend_needs_reload and not self.trend_paused:
            self.load_trend_charts()
            self.trend_needs_reload = False
            self.trend_chart_sequence = self.sequence
        elif not self.trend_paused and self.trend_chart_sequence != self.sequence:
            ui.tr_temp_chart.set_next_value(self.tr_temp_series, int(self.temp * 10))
            ui.tr_fan_chart.set_next_value(self.tr_fan_series, int(self.rpm))
            self.trend_chart_sequence = self.sequence
        temp_stats = self.temp_history.stats(self.trend_window, 10)
        fan_stats = self.fan_history.stats(self.trend_window)
        set_label(ui.tr_temp_stats, "MIN %.1f   MAX %.1f   AVG %.1f" % temp_stats if temp_stats else "MIN N/A   MAX N/A   AVG N/A", 0xB9C8D6)
        set_label(ui.tr_fan_stats, "MIN %d   MAX %d   AVG %d" % tuple(int(v) for v in fan_stats) if fan_stats else "MIN N/A   MAX N/A   AVG N/A", 0xB9C8D6)

    def load_trend_charts(self):
        size = min(self.trend_window, self.temp_history.count)
        if size < 1:
            return
        ui.tr_temp_chart.set_point_count(size)
        ui.tr_fan_chart.set_point_count(size)
        temp_values = self.temp_history.latest(self.trend_window)
        fan_values = self.fan_history.latest(self.trend_window)
        for i in range(size):
            ui.tr_temp_chart.set_series_value_by_id(self.tr_temp_series, i, temp_values[i])
            ui.tr_fan_chart.set_series_value_by_id(self.tr_fan_series, i, fan_values[i])
        ui.tr_temp_chart.refresh()
        ui.tr_fan_chart.refresh()

    def refresh_alarms(self):
        active = 0
        acknowledged = 0
        cleared = 0
        for i in range(5):
            alarm = self.alarms[i]
            state = alarm["state"]
            if state == "ACTIVE":
                active += 1
                color = RED
            elif state == "ACKNOWLEDGED":
                acknowledged += 1
                color = AMBER
            else:
                cleared += 1
                color = MUTED
            set_label(getattr(ui, "al_state_%d" % i), state, color)
            set_label(getattr(ui, "al_time_%d" % i), alarm["time"], 0x9FB2C5)
        summary_text = ("%d A • %d K • %d C" if self.compact else "%d ACTIVE  •  %d ACKNOWLEDGED  •  %d CLEARED") % (active, acknowledged, cleared)
        set_label(ui.al_summary, summary_text, 0xB9C8D6)

    def refresh_diagnostics(self):
        set_label(ui.di_source_value, SOURCE_NAMES[self.source], GREEN if self.source == 0 else 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_connection_value, SOURCE_NAMES[self.source] if self.link_up() else "OFFLINE", GREEN if self.link_up() else RED)
        set_label(ui.di_rx_value, str(self.received), 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_discarded_value, str(self.discarded), 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_sequence_value, str(self.sequence) if self.sequence else "N/A", 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_scenario_value, SCENARIO_NAMES[self.scenario], 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_uptime_value, clock_text(self.uptime()), 0xE7F0F8)
        set_label(ui.di_refresh_value, "%d ms" % self.refresh_ms, 0xE7F0F8)
        memory = "N/A"
        if gc is not None and hasattr(gc, "mem_free"):
            try:
                memory = "%d bytes" % gc.mem_free()
            except Exception:
                memory = "N/A"
        set_label(ui.di_memory_value, memory, 0xE7F0F8)


def set_label(widget, value, color=None):
    value = str(value)
    if widget.get_text() != value:
        widget.set_text(value)
    if color is not None:
        widget.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(color), lv.PART.MAIN)


def set_led(widget, color):
    widget.set_color(lv.color_hex(color))


def set_button(widget, value):
    child = widget.get_child(0)
    if child is not None and child.get_text() != value:
        child.set_text(value)


app = EIMApplication()


def navigate(index):
    ui.load_page((ui.PAGE_OVERVIEW, ui.PAGE_TRENDS, ui.PAGE_ALARMS, ui.PAGE_DIAGNOSTICS, ui.PAGE_SETTINGS)[index])


def update_scenario_description():
    set_label(ui.se_scenario_desc, SCENARIO_DESCRIPTIONS[ui.se_scenario.get_selected()] + " Select RUN to activate.", 0xB9C8D6)
